name: Professional Scrum Developer
name_ja: プロフェッショナル・スクラム・ディベロッパー

logistics.format: Online open-book multiple-choice assessment; passing score 85%

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 2, introductory: 1. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Developer-oriented Scrum knowledge provides an entry delivery-process foundation; zero experience, open-book multiple-choice testing and non-security scope do not demonstrate applied secure-development competence.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Developer-focused Scrum concepts provide foundational team-process knowledge. The open-entry multiple-choice exam assesses no coding or security implementation, so the Professional title does not establish applied developer seniority.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded developer-oriented Scrum assessment tests framework knowledge without coding tasks or experience requirements. The Professional label and global recognition do not establish technical security practice.
